steps.en: Install core plus the model integration you want, and set its API key
steps.zh: 装好核心包和你要的模型集成包，配好 API key
steps.code: pip install llama-index-core · pip install llama-index-llms-openai

steps.en: Load a folder of files and build an index over them
steps.zh: 读入一个文件夹，在上面建索引

steps.en: Splits the files into chunks, embeds each chunk, stores the vectors (in memory by default)
steps.zh: 把文件切成小段，逐段向量化，存起向量（默认放内存）

steps.en: Ask a question through a query engine
steps.zh: 通过查询引擎提一个问题

steps.en: Retrieves the closest chunks, writes them into the prompt, returns the LLM's grounded answer
steps.zh: 取回最相近的几段写进提示词，返回大模型基于这些段落的回答

value.en: Answers come from your own documents instead of the model's memory, without hand-writing chunking, embedding or retrieval
value.zh: 答案来自你自己的文档而不是模型的记忆，切分、向量化、检索都不用手写

sources: https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index#-example-usage (pip install llama-index-core / llama-index-llms-openai, SimpleDirectoryReader, VectorStoreIndex.from_documents, index.as_query_engine, query_engine.query("YOUR_QUESTION"), in-memory by default)
